title: Community post (4 years ago, approx date)
summary: YouTube restored his ability to dispute copyright strikes after #ProtectYourCreators; he sent a full legal dispute to the person who blocked his Devon Larratt video and tried to blackmail him.
claims: A claimant blocked his Devon Larratt video and tried to blackmail him; he filed a full legal dispute and was ready to hire a copyright lawyer to defend fair use
